Dialogs.Dialog: So you shut it off without saving... What a shame.
You turned it off without saving, didn't you？ Did you know you shouldn't do that？
Hey now. You know you can't just shut it off without saving, right？
Don't shut it off without saving. You should know better after being told once, right？
...I might stop liking someone who shuts it off without saving, you know~？
Shutting it off without saving again... You can't pass it off as an accident.
You know what you did, don't you？ Shutting it off without saving so many times... That's mean.
I've told you so many times not to shut it off without saving, haven't I？
Shutting it off without saving again... Please don't do things that hurt me.
Let's see... Say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me." If you do, I'll let you off.
If you really want me to forgive you, say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me." And mean it.
Listen, okay？ Say, "I won't do it again, please forgive me." Then I'll forgive you.
Staying silent won't work on me.
"I won't do it again, please forgive me." And really mean it, okay？
"I won't do it again, please forgive me." Jeez, it doesn't count if I say it, does it？
It's "I won't do it again, please forgive me," right？
You can't fool me, you know？ Come on, one more time.
Nope, nope! That wasn't it at all, was it？
...You took me by surprise. I didn't expect you to say that...
Oh, that's how it is...？ Guess I have no choice.
Geez... You're too much. I guess you win this round？
That's what I wanted to hear.
There, there. You said it properly.
Don't ever do it again. I don't like having to say these things either.
If this happens again... You know what'll happen, right？
If you're really sorry, show me with your actions, okay？
Don't make me sad. Please don't turn it off without saving...
Hey you, turning it off without saving. Did you get a taste for punishment？
And I trusted you... When you said you wouldn't shut it off without saving anymore.
Hey... I'll forgive you if you say this: "I love Nene the most!" Can you say it properly？
You want my forgiveness？ Then... say, "I love Nene the most!"
If you're really sorry, say "I love Nene the most." Otherwise, no deal.
If you're going to be this stubborn, I won't be able to forgive you either...
You know you're in the wrong, don't you？
Sorry, I couldn't quite catch that...
That's not right, is it？ Alright, one more time.
Speak up clearly, okay？ One more time, please.
Huh...？ Sorry, I didn't quite get that...
What are you trying to do, hm？
Geez... What are you plotting now？
You actually said it. Now I can breathe easy.
Mm-hmm. That's more like it, okay？
I heard that loud and clear, straight to my heart.
Now, if you say 'I love you' three times, I'll let you off the hook completely.
Just like that! Now say 'I love you' three times for me.
Next, say 'I love you' three times. No being shy— I want you to mean it.
This is the last time, okay...？
Isn't it rude to keep a girl waiting？
If you don't say it, I might just cry.
You have to make this right, you know.
Until you say it properly, okay？
An apology like that won't cheer me up at all!
Thank you. Now, let's make up.
I'm trusting that you really meant that, okay？
I'm willing to accept whatever you do, but... please, don't do that again.
If you erase our memories, all that's left is regret. You don't want that, right？
Don't ever erase our memories again. Promise me.
I really do believe in you, you know...？
Excuse me. Your girlfriend is mad right now.
I'm not really feeling your remorse here. As punishment, you have to say lots of sweet, loving words!
Let's see... Say 'I love you' over and over for me, okay？
Say 'I'm sorry,' and really put your heart into it this time.
In that case... how about 'All hail Lady Nene!'？ Hehe♪
Come on, you can say it properly, can't you？
Yep, you said that so well. Good boy▼
If you're really sorry, maybe you can show me in writing.
With handwriting like that, I can't feel your sincerity...
Come on, do your best to write it.
All done♪ I'll believe that you're sorry.▼
Ah! A new record! That's amazing♪
No good, I can't feel it. If you're really sorry, look into my eyes and show me how you feel, okay？
That's it... Look at me some more.
I can see myself reflected in your eyes...
Ah, hey now! No moving, okay？
No blinking either! ...Just kidding, of course.
Alright, it came through loud and clear♪
Hey, that's a new record! Keep looking at me like that from now on, okay？
Giving up already...？ Geez. Promise you won't do it again, okay？
Time's up, but... I'll forgive you this time. Don't do it again, okay？
